description: This Java source file defines a 'SignalFilter' class responsible for filtering targets based on authorization, subscription, and topic criteria in a messaging system within the Eclipse Ditto project. It processes signals such as commands and events to determine eligible targets for dispatch.

classes.name: SignalFilter
classes.description: A final class responsible for filtering a set of targets based on authorization, subscription, and topic filter criteria, for dispatching signals in the messaging system.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the given signal to determine the list of Target instances that should receive it, based on various security and subscription criteria.

methods.name: isTargetAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the target has the necessary authorization to read the headers associated with the signal.

methods.name: isTargetSubscribedForTopicGenerally
methods.description: Determines if a target is generally subscribed to the topic associated with the signal.

methods.name: isTargetSubscribedForTopicWithFiltering
methods.description: Checks if a target is subscribed to the specific filtered topic with namespace and filter considerations.

methods.name: applyTopicFilter
methods.description: Creates a predicate to match topics to the topic derived from the signal.

methods.name: applyNamespaceFilter
methods.description: Creates a predicate to filter topics based on namespace inclusion.

methods.name: namespaceFromId
methods.description: Extracts the namespace from an entity ID if present.

methods.name: matchesFilterBeforeEnrichment
methods.description: Determines if a filtered topic matches the criteria specified in the signal, particularly for ThingEvents.

methods.name: parseCriteria
methods.description: Parses a filter string into a Criteria object, handling potential exceptions related to invalid RQL expressions.

methods.name: topicFromSignal
methods.description: Derives a Topic object based on the type and content of the signal (such as events, commands, or messages).

methods.name: getCriterionOfSignal
methods.description: Identifies the criterion (commands, events, messages) associated with a given signal, if applicable.
